mapper.select: SELECT PRJCT_ROLE.COMP_SEQ , PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_CD , PRJCT_ROLE.USE_YN , PRJCT_ROLE.DISP_ORD , PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_NM , PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_DESC , COMP.COMP_NM , TO_CHAR(PRJCT_ROLE.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , PRJCT_ROLE.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = PRJCT_ROLE.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(PRJCT_ROLE.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , PRJCT_ROLE.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = PRJCT_ROLE.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM PRJ_PRJCT_ROLE_BSC_INFO_TBL PRJCT_ROLE LEFT JOIN CMP_COMP_INFO_TBL COMP ON PRJCT_ROLE.COMP_SEQ = COMP.COMP_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND ((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') OR (PRJCT_ROLE.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND PRJCT_ROLE.DELT_YN = 'N' AND ((#{compSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR #{compSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0) OR (PRJCT_ROLE.COMP_SEQ = #{compSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND ((#{prjctRoleNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctRoleNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') OR (PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_NM LIKE '%' || #{prjctRoleNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')) ORDER BY PRJCT_ROLE.DISP_ORD ASC

SELECT PRJCT_ROLE.COMP_SEQ , PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_CD , PRJCT_ROLE.USE_YN , PRJCT_ROLE.DISP_ORD , PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_NM , PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_DESC , COMP.COMP_NM , TO_CHAR(PRJCT_ROLE.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , PRJCT_ROLE.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = PRJCT_ROLE.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(PRJCT_ROLE.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , PRJCT_ROLE.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = PRJCT_ROLE.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM PRJ_PRJCT_ROLE_BSC_INFO_TBL PRJCT_ROLE LEFT JOIN CMP_COMP_INFO_TBL COMP ON PRJCT_ROLE.COMP_SEQ = COMP.COMP_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (PRJCT_ROLE.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )) AND PRJCT_ROLE.DELT_YN = 'N' AND PRJCT_ROLE.COMP_SEQ = #{compSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND PRJCT_ROLE.PRJCT_ROLE_CD = #{prjctRoleCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
